title: WorkspaceRevision
description: Immutable run-scoped repository and exact commit binding. Only successful deterministic task results can establish it; identical re-emission is idempotent and replacement fails closed. Accepted history preserves the exact binding for replay without resolving moving refs. Its absence in older histories preserves configured-base behavior. The binding does not replace configured writable-base identity, establish workspaceBranch ownership, or carry workspace deltas.

repository.description: Canonical selected repository identity, subject to configuration authorization before acquisition.

commitSha.description: Full lowercase SHA-1 or SHA-256 Git commit object ID; never a branch or abbreviated SHA.

sourceRef.description: Optional source-ref display provenance. Never resolved for checkout or used as publication authority.

sourceId.description: Optional source or pull-request identifier for provenance.

baseRepository.description: Optional canonical base repository for base-relative evidence; does not change the configured writable target.

baseSha.description: Optional full lowercase base commit object ID for base-relative evidence.

sha.description: A full lowercase Git SHA-1 or SHA-256 object ID.
